votes.question: Motion to Proceed to S.J. Res. 199
votes.bill_title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)".
votes.plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S.J.Res. 199, whose official title is “A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Restoring Flexibility in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)"”. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.
